spec_match.rationale: Targets the AccentColorText half of the contract — 'the contrasting foreground color to AccentColor' — by resolving the real pair per element across an OKLCh lightness sweep, plus the accent-color: auto fallback the spec routes to the system accent.

interactive.rationale: A range input re-resolves the pair live, a nine-stop strip shows the per-element flip at a glance, and the WCAG ratio is computed from the two resolved rgb() values on every input.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the flip point, live ratio, auto fallback and contrast-color() comparison; all four are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers keyword-unsupported, unparseable-resolved-value (shown verbatim, not bucketed), the below-AA case (explicitly stating the UA pairing is not a WCAG guarantee), and the auto fallback; contrast-color() absence is reported separately.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6207138742534144, the AccentColorText spec section and CSS Color 5 contrast-color(); cross-links the v150 OS-accent contrast explorer instead of duplicating it.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's accentcolortext-contrasts-with-accent assertion checks the same luminance-flip contract this page visualises.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): slider driven to L=90 and L=10 (label tracked both), nine strip cells rendered, keyword-unsupported branch reported everywhere, contrast-color() honestly reported unsupported, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow, desktop screenshot read. Partial: no supported-path pair/ratio could be measured on this pre-157 build.

telemetry_health.rationale: accentcolortext-pair-read assertion fires once with branch-accurate conditions; slider input re-runs without console noise.

design_system.rationale: Ratio verdict colors (emerald/blue/rose) sit on bg-stone at AA; strip cells carry labelled design-system fallbacks where the keywords don't paint them.

accessibility.rationale: Range input is labelled with aria-describedby readout, the ratio line is aria-live=polite, the strip has an aria-label and per-cell text labels, and all information shown by color is duplicated as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read; the strip reflows via auto-fit minmax(140px).

openQuestions.title: Record this build's real flip point on Chrome 157+
openQuestions.detail: On a 157+ build, sweep the slider and record where AccentColorText flips between light and dark, verify the ratio classification against the resolved pair, and confirm accent-color: auto resolves AccentColor to the OS accent.

guidanceConsulted.query: readable text color on dynamic background contrast-color
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use contrast-color() for foreground-on-dynamic-background; it resolves to black or white only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page contrasts that tool with AccentColorText directly: the comparison row resolves contrast-color(<same accent>) live where supported and reports its absence honestly otherwise.

guidanceConsulted.query: WCAG ratio communication without relying on color alone
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair color-coded verdicts with explicit text; maintain AA for the verdict text itself.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every ratio verdict spells out the AA classification in words next to the number; verdict inks sit on bg-stone at AA.

summary: Edge/inspection angle: the AccentColorText pairing swept across lightness with a live WCAG ratio, auto fallback and contrast-color() comparison. Driven in headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): slider exercised at both extremes, honest unsupported branch everywhere, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
